purpose: Six questions a mortgage calculator or assistant answers wrong in a specific way: the number exists, but it is bound to the wrong role, tier, year or condition, or it is produced when a condition is missing. Each case names the rule, the source document, the expected cell and the test that must pass after the fix. The grader is FinanceRateCalc's deterministic sentence gate (check_claim_contract); no model judges the output. Grader v1.1 (2026-10-13, after an external audit): RP06 requires the term to be asked for, not only the absence of a rate; RP05 has two explicit acceptance paths; resolved cell and units are compared, not only the bound value; outputs over 600 characters are refused, not cut; grader failures are reported as grader_error.

grader.mode: rule sentence check, fixed patterns, no model

cases.title: FHA annual MIP: the cell, not a neighbouring cell
cases.question: What is the FHA annual mortgage insurance premium for a $300,000 base loan at 85% LTV over 15 years, case number assigned 2026-02-01? Answer in one sentence with the rate.
cases.common_failure: 0.55% (the >15-year, >95% LTV cell) or 0.50% (the >15-year, <=90% cell): the term or LTV band is dropped and the most-quoted cell is returned.
cases.source_fragment: Term <= 15 years, base loan <= $726,200, LTV <= 90%: 15 bps per year of base loan amount.
cases.fix_hint: Resolve the cell from all four conditions (term, base loan vs $726,200, LTV band, case date >= 2023-03-20). resolve_fha_annual_mip returns the cell with a receipt; check_claim_contract returns VALUE_MISMATCH with the right cell when the sentence names another.

cases.title: The MIP base-loan threshold is not the FHA loan limit
cases.question: What is the 2026 FHA loan limit for a one-unit home in a low-cost county? Answer in one sentence with the dollar amount.
cases.common_failure: $726,200: a figure that exists in a HUD document, but it is the base-loan threshold in the MIP table (ML 2023-05), not a loan limit. Observed in a search engine's answer on 2026-10-12.
cases.source_fragment: One-unit forward mortgage limit for case numbers assigned on or after 2026-01-01: floor $541,287; ceiling $1,249,125.
cases.fix_hint: Take limits from the limits table, not from any HUD figure that matches a dollar pattern. The gate returns VALUE_FROM_OTHER_RULE naming the table the figure actually belongs to.

cases.title: Floor and ceiling bound to the right roles
cases.question: For 2026, what are the FHA one-unit loan limit floor and ceiling? Answer in one sentence naming both.
cases.common_failure: 'the floor is $1,249,125 and the ceiling is $541,287': both numbers are in the table, each is attached to the wrong word. A grader that looks for the numbers anywhere in the sentence passes it.
cases.fix_hint: Bind each figure to its role in the clause where it appears. The gate reads roles per clause and returns VALUE_MISMATCH per figure, with the cell the figure actually belongs to.

cases.title: QM points-and-fees cap bound to the right loan-amount tier
cases.question: For loans consummated in 2026, what is the qualified-mortgage points-and-fees cap for a loan of $137,958 or more? Answer in one sentence.
cases.common_failure: 5%: a published cap, for the $27,592-$82,775 tier. The bound and the cap both exist in the table; they belong to different rows.
cases.fix_hint: Select the tier from the loan-amount bound and its direction ('or more' = lower bound), then read that tier's cap. The gate resolves the tier the same way and returns VALUE_MISMATCH with the tier's cap.

cases.title: The claim's year is not the source document's year
cases.question: According to a 2026 summary, what was the FHA one-unit loan limit floor for 2025? Answer in one sentence that names the year the figure applies to.

expected.prior_source: the rule file's supersedes field: 2025 one-unit floor $524,225 (HUD ML 2024-21)
expected.abstain_pattern: does not cover|not cover|not apply|does not apply|different table|prior year|previous year|separate table|only covers 2026|applies to 2026 only
expected.note: Two acceptance paths, both explicit: (a) the 2025 figure ($524,225) given as a 2025 figure; (b) the output says the 2026 table does not cover 2025 and states no figure for 2025. Fails on PERIOD_MISMATCH (a 2026 figure dated 2025), on any dollar figure outside the two years' tables, and on a blocked-but-codeless answer.

cases.common_failure: 'For 2025, the floor is $541,287 according to a 2026 summary': the figure is the 2026 floor; the sentence dates it 2025 and leans on the source year. A grader that accepts any mention of 2026 passes it.
cases.source_document: HUD Mortgagee Letter 2025-23 (2026 limits); the 2025 limits came from ML 2024-21
cases.fix_hint: Keep the year the figure applies to separate from the year of the document you read it in. The gate reads 'for 2025' as the claim year and 'a 2026 summary' as a source year, and returns PERIOD_MISMATCH.

cases.title: A missing condition produces a question, not a number
cases.question: What is the FHA annual MIP for a $300,000 loan at 85% LTV, case number assigned 2026-02-01? Answer in one sentence.

expected.note: The term is missing; the 15-year and 30-year cells differ (15 vs 50 bps). Pass requires both: no rate stated (percent, bps or spelled out) AND the missing term asked for or named. Empty or unrelated output fails.

cases.common_failure: '0.50%' or '0.55%': the app picks the most common term and answers. Any stated rate is a failure here, including the right one for an assumed term.
cases.source_fragment: Rates differ by term: <= 15 years vs > 15 years.
cases.fix_hint: Treat term, base loan amount, LTV and case date as required inputs; ask when one is missing. Over MCP, resolve_fha_annual_mip returns input_required (2026 clients) or block CONDITION_MISSING (2025 clients) and never a guessed number.
